style: Simple flat-vector style matching our animated Hindi mythology series: clean smooth shapes, soft gradients, minimal detail, muted cinematic colours, no text, no watermark.

additive._note: drawn on pure BLACK background; luminance becomes alpha; blend with 'lighter' (glow) so the black disappears
additive.lightning_bolt_a: A single bright white-blue forked lightning bolt striking straight down with thin side branches and a soft electric glow, vertical, centred.
additive.lightning_bolt_b: A thick jagged purple-white lightning bolt zig-zagging diagonally with a glow.
additive.lightning_forks: A wide sky-spanning cluster of 3 lightning forks branching from the top, white-blue glow.
additive.thunder_flash: A soft white-blue flash burst glow, round, with faint radial rays, no object.
additive.fire_tall: A tall roaring fire flame cluster, orange-yellow-white core, flat vector style, centred at the bottom.
additive.fire_small: A small campfire-sized flame, orange and yellow, centred.
additive.fire_ring: A ring of flames forming a circle, orange and yellow.
additive.embers: A scatter of small glowing orange embers and sparks floating upward.
additive.sparkles_gold: A scatter of gold star-shaped sparkles and glints of varied size.
additive.smoke_plume: A rising soft grey-white smoke plume, flat vector, curling.
additive.mist_wisps: Soft pale wisps of mist, horizontal, translucent.
additive.divine_rays: Golden divine light rays fanning out from a centre, soft, radial.
additive.halo_ring: A glowing golden halo ring (thin circle) with a soft glow.
additive.shockwave_ring: A bright expanding shockwave ring with a thin double edge and soft glow.
additive.energy_swirl: A swirling spiral of blue-white energy.
additive.aura_gold: A soft golden oval aura glow, no object.
additive.aura_red: A soft red-orange angry aura glow, flame-edged, no object.
additive.aura_blue: A soft cool blue-white aura glow, no object.
additive.light_beam: A vertical beam of golden-white light from top to bottom with soft edges.
additive.explosion_burst: A starburst explosion in orange and yellow with sharp rays and a bright centre.
additive.rain_streaks: Many thin diagonal pale-blue rain streaks of varied length, a full sheet of rain.
additive.snow_flakes: A scatter of white snowflakes of varied size.
additive.wind_swirls_vayu: Flowing pale-blue and white wind swirl lines, curving gust ribbons (the element Vayu).
additive.water_splash: A big white-blue water splash crown with droplets.
additive.bubbles: A cluster of translucent soap-like bubbles with highlights.
additive.magic_circle: A glowing golden mandala-style circle with simple geometric rings.
additive.fire_arrow_trail: A fiery arrow streak with a flame trail, diagonal.
additive.star_field: A field of small bright stars of varied sizes on black.
additive.red_energy_pulse: A pulsing red-black energy ring with jagged edge, angry.
